import pandas as pd

def _clean(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Convert numeric columns, drop missing keys, keep positive quantities."""
    df['Quantity'] = pd.to_numeric(df['Quantity'], errors='coerce')
    df['UnitPrice'] = pd.to_numeric(df['UnitPrice'], errors='coerce')
    df = df.dropna(subset=['StockCode', 'Description'])
    df = df[df['Quantity'] > 0]
    return df

def main(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    path_2010 = '{path_2010}'
    path_2011 = '{path_2011}'
    df_2010 = pd.read_csv(path_2010)
    df_2011 = pd.read_csv(path_2011)
    required_cols = {'StockCode', 'Description', 'Quantity', 'UnitPrice'}
    for name, data in (('df_2010', df_2010), ('df_2011', df_2011)):
        missing = required_cols - set(data.columns)
        if missing:
            raise ValueError(f'{name} is missing required columns: {missing}')
    df_2010 = _clean(df_2010)
    df_2011 = _clean(df_2011)
    df_2010['Period'] = '2010_Q4'
    df_2011['Period'] = '2011_Q1'
    df_all = pd.concat([df_2010, df_2011], ignore_index=True)
    df_all['Revenue'] = df_all['Quantity'] * df_all['UnitPrice']
    product_summary = df_all.groupby(['StockCode', 'Description'], as_index=False).agg(TotalQuantity=('Quantity', 'sum'), TotalRevenue=('Revenue', 'sum'))
    product_summary['TotalQuantity'] = product_summary['TotalQuantity'].clip(lower=0)
    product_summary['TotalRevenue'] = product_summary['TotalRevenue'].clip(lower=0)
    return product_summary
if __name__ == '__main__':
    try:
        df = pd.read_csv('input.csv')
    except FileNotFoundError:
        df = pd.DataFrame()
    result_df = main(df)
    result_df.to_csv('output.csv', index=False)

customers.code:
import pandas as pd

def main(df):
    customers_path = '{customers_path}'
    orders_path = '{orders_path}'
    customers = pd.read_csv(customers_path)
    orders = pd.read_csv(orders_path)
    non_returned = orders[orders['returned'] == False]
    spend_per_customer = non_returned.groupby('customer_id', as_index=False)['amount'].sum().rename(columns={'amount': 'total_amount'})
    spend_per_customer = spend_per_customer.sort_values('total_amount', ascending=False)
    merged = spend_per_customer.merge(customers, on='customer_id', how='left')
    result = merged[['customer_id', 'total_amount', 'region', 'signup_year', 'segment']]
    return result
if __name__ == '__main__':
    df = read_csv_best_effort('input.csv')
    df = main(df)
    df.to_csv('output.csv', index=False)

scope_turn.question: What drives Outcome?
scope_turn.code:
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from scipy.stats import pearsonr

def main(df):
    df_2022 = read_csv_best_effort('{path_2022}')
    df_2023 = read_csv_best_effort('{path_2023}')
    df_all = pd.concat([df_2022, df_2023], ignore_index=True)
    df_all['Outcome'] = df_all['Outcome'].astype(str).str.strip().str.title().replace({'nan': np.nan})
    df_all['Glucose_num'] = pd.to_numeric(df_all['Glucose'], errors='coerce')
    df_all['visit_dt'] = pd.to_datetime(df_all['visit_date'], errors='coerce')
    df_all['visit_year'] = df_all['visit_dt'].dt.year
    df_all['Notes_len'] = df_all['Notes'].fillna('').astype(str).str.len()
    df_valid = df_all[df_all['Outcome'].notna()].copy()
    outcome_codes, _ = pd.factorize(df_valid['Outcome'], sort=True)

    def safe_pearson(x, y):
        mask = pd.notna(x) & pd.notna(y)
        if mask.sum() < 2:
            return np.nan
        return pearsonr(x[mask], y[mask])[0]
    corr_glucose = safe_pearson(df_valid['Glucose_num'], outcome_codes)
    corr_year = safe_pearson(df_valid['visit_year'], outcome_codes)
    corr_notes = safe_pearson(df_valid['Notes_len'], outcome_codes)
    agg = df_valid.groupby('Outcome', as_index=False).agg(record_count=('patient_id', 'size'), mean_glucose=('Glucose_num', 'mean'), median_glucose=('Glucose_num', 'median'), std_glucose=('Glucose_num', 'std'), mean_visit_year=('visit_year', 'mean'), std_visit_year=('visit_year', 'std'), mean_note_len=('Notes_len', 'mean'), std_note_len=('Notes_len', 'std'))
    agg['corr_glucose_outcome'] = corr_glucose
    agg['corr_year_outcome'] = corr_year
    agg['corr_notes_outcome'] = corr_notes
    agg['record_count'] = agg['record_count'].astype(float)
    return agg
